title: Puppy holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M68 42 Q72 55 66 62' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='28' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='22' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff9db0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M66 43 L72 43 L69 47 Z' fill='#c9184a'/>
  <!-- puppy body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#e0a86b'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='74' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f7d9b6'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='80' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e0a86b'/>
  <rect x='46' y='80' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e0a86b'/>
  <rect x='32' y='88' width='7' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#f7d9b6'/>
  <rect x='46' y='88' width='7' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#f7d9b6'/>
  <!-- raised arm holding string -->
  <path d='M56 62 Q62 56 66 60' stroke='#e0a86b' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='#f7d9b6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='18' fill='#e0a86b'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='38' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#b5783f' transform='rotate(-20 21 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='38' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#b5783f' transform='rotate(20 55 38)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='52' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f7d9b6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='42' r='3' fill='#3d2b1f'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='42' r='3' fill='#3d2b1f'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='41' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='41' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='49' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#4a3222'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M38 51 Q38 55 34 55' stroke='#8a5a33' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 51 Q38 55 42 55' stroke='#8a5a33' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='57' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#ff7a9a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 66 Q14 60 16 52' stroke='#e0a86b' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
